rows.title: Hang On
notes: “This is Peter Guttridge, the song called Hang On.”
Track on 'Pure' (originally 1989 cassette, reissued Dec 2023) by the late NZ Flying Nun/Clean/Snapper figure.

rows.title: Meshes
notes: “Before that, Soot out of Brisbane with a song called Meshes. That was off their 2020 release, Silt”
Track on Brisbane band Soot's 2020 album 'Silt', matching the presenter's own description exactly.

rows.title: Negative Gear
notes: “Up the top there, played you a brand new track from Negative Gears, entitled Negative Gear”
Opening track of 'Moraliser' (2024), the Sydney punk band's newest full-length at the time.

rows.title: No Lateral Line
notes: “In the middle, that was The Sheaves out of Phoenix, Arizona ... that song was called No Lateral Line”
From 'A Salve For Institution' (2024), second LP by this Phoenix, Arizona post-punk band.

rows.title: Pieces
notes: “This song was called Pieces And it came out on the album Songs from 2019 to 2022 Out on Wartman Inc You're listening to it on Real to Real This is Bea Shatner”
Track on 'Songs From 2019 - 2022' (Warttmann Inc, 2023); presenter's 'Bea Shatner' is an ASR mishearing of B Schattner.

rows.title: Tona Tona
notes: “that was Mura with a song called Tona Tona”
From the retrospective LP '2008-2021' by Japanese group Mura, released 2022 on An'archives.

rows.title: Please Patronize Our Sponsors
notes: “off the amazing album Eureka, is called Please Patronise Our Sponsors”
Instrumental track on O'Rourke's 1999 album Eureka (Drag City), exactly as announced.

rows.title: Live in Kumamoto Part Two
notes: “you heard an excerpt of live in kumamoto part two of the live at mandako in kumamoto album that's put out by eiko shibasi and jim o'rourke”
From 'Live at Mandako in Kumamoto' (2021), a duo recording at a disused Kumamoto coal mine, Japan.

rows.title: Interlude
notes: “a brief interlude as it is also called interlude it's by a local experimental uh improvised three-piece string club um and that was off their new release called how long”
Improvised piece by Sydney trio, from their 2024 EP 'How Long'.

rows.title: Natasha Kinski
notes: “Drunk Elk just there out of Hobart in Tasmania and that is a song called Natasha Kinski”
From the self-titled Drunk Elk LP (Goaty Tapes/House Rules), Hobart, Tasmania band.

rows.title: Flood
notes: “And at the top, Powder Blue with Flood”
Second track on Powder Blue's 'canoe/flood' two-song release.

rows.title: Flag for Gravity
notes: “Before that, a beautiful track from People Skills based out of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania... That was the song called Flag for Gravity off an album called Hum of the Non-Engine”
Track on 2023 LP 'Hum of the Non-Engine' (Digital Regress), Philadelphia artist.

rows.title: Tree People
notes: “that was Daily Toll off the album, or EP rather, Sing Forever... That song is called Tree People”
Track on 'Sing Forever' EP/comp of demos, later reissued as a 12" via Tough Love.
“This is Shizuka out of Tokyo... The album's called Lunatic”
Tokyo psych band's real 2022 EP is 'Lunatic Pearl' (An'archives); specific track not identifiable from what was said.
“at the end that there was a band called fushitsusha legendary kind of noise rock band headed by keiji hano”
Legendary Japanese noise/psych rock band led by Keiji Haino; no track name given on air.
“With Kun Kaku Wang Kapai off the beautiful album Willu Rada Kutu out on Alton State's tapes late last year.”

rows.title: I Am Trying to Break Your Heart
notes: 2002 Nonesuch

rows.title: I Die
notes: “I Die There by amazing local band, Karnations, off their debut self-titled release... on Urge Records”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Opening track on Carnations' 2023 self-titled debut cassette (Urge Records); real title is 'I Die', not 'I Die There'.

rows.title: Spitting Pink

mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Track on V.I.P.P — II (2023), Sydney's Volunteers In Policing Program.
